Earlier this week I went to do my dinner shopping at Wal-Mart, when I do I always enjoy window shopping at the garden section to think about what I'm getting next time. This time I found out something really cool!

At WM you can get plants on clearance prices (50%>) because if they are root bound, nutrient deficient, or just starting to wither and die they put it on clearance because they don't know how or can't fix it.

I bought a tall snapdragon seedling for $0.48 because it was root bound and it was damaged in a couple spots. Got home and put it in a new pot and pruned it a bit and now it's flourishing! So awesome!
I went there once while looking to see which store I can get supplies for the cheapest and I bought 4 snow pea plants for $2 and a 10 lb bag of soil for 2.50 because the print was fading.
